generate_text: generate text using a StreamExecutor and SglSamplingParams with the backend generate method
generate_stream_text: generate text stream using a StreamExecutor and SglSamplingParams with the backend generate_stream method
select_from_choices: select from a list of choices using a StreamExecutor, temperature, and optional choices method
cache_prefix_text: cache a prefix string for efficient reuse in subsequent generation requests
fork_program_state: fork a source StreamExecutor into multiple destination StreamExecutors with position id offsets
